description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of EmployeeDependentDao related to employee dependents, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching dependents within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of EmployeeDependentDao methods related to employee dependents in the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating EmployeeDependentDao and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent with minimal data and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent with a specific sequence number and additional details.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Verifies that saving an employee dependent with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests retrieving all dependents for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific dependent of an employee by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Verifies that deleting dependents correctly removes them from the storage.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests searching dependents with various filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentCount
methods.description: Verifies counting dependents matching search criteria.
